mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns do not correlate positively with the 3-month trend of FEDFUNDS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5 percent, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's tightening response depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns do not correlate positively with the 3-month trend of PAYEMS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550,000 units, it signals weakening residential demand that reduces economic growth momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 550, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening in response to labor market weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In industrial contraction periods (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
